lines.beaver_en: You've gotten slimmer lately! Did you diet?
lines.learner: 응, 다이어트 좀 했어. 처음엔 많이 힘들었어.
lines.en: Yeah, I dieted a bit. It was really hard at first.
lines.roman: eung, daieoteu jom haesseo. cheoeumen mani himdeureosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Dieting is hard, right? What did you do at first?
lines.learner: 처음엔 그냥 밥을 굶었어. 너무 배고팠어.
lines.en: At first I just skipped meals. I was so hungry.
lines.roman: cheoeumen geunyang babeul gulmeosseo. neomu baegopasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Don't you lose weight fast if you skip meals?
lines.learner: 아니야. 우리 언니는 굶더니 오히려 살이 쪘어.
lines.en: No. My sister skipped meals and actually gained weight.
lines.roman: aniya. uri eonnineun gumdeoni ohiryeo sari jjyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Then what did you do?
lines.learner: 나는 소식을 했어. 조금씩 자주 먹었어.
lines.en: I ate light. I ate small amounts often.
lines.roman: naneun sosigeul haesseo. jogeumssik jaju meogeosseo.

lines.learner: 아니. 친구는 영양제만 먹더니 자꾸 피곤해했어.
lines.en: No. My friend took only supplements and was always tired.
lines.roman: ani. chinguneun yeongyangjeman meokdeoni jakku pigonhaehaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Did you weigh yourself every day?
lines.learner: 응, 매일 쟀어. 살이 조금씩 빠졌어.
lines.en: Yes, every day. I slowly lost weight.
lines.roman: eung, maeil jaesseo. sari jogeumssik ppajyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, amazing! You exercised too, right?
lines.en: Yeah. I walked every day, so my body felt lighter.

lines.beaver: 건강하게 먹는 법에 대해 더 얘기해 볼래?
lines.beaver_en: Want to talk more about how to eat healthily?
lines.beaver_roman: geonganghage meongneun beobe daehae deo yaegihae bollae?
lines.learner: 좋아. 각자 몸에 맞게 먹는 게 제일 중요해.
lines.en: Sure. Eating what suits each person's body matters most.
lines.roman: joa. gakja mome matge meongneun ge jeil jungyohae.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 요즘은 음식에 칼로리가 적혀 있잖아.
lines.beaver_en: Right. These days calories are written on food.
lines.beaver_roman: maja. yojeumeun eumsige kalloriga jeokyeo itjana.
lines.learner: 응, 나는 적힌 칼로리를 꼭 보고 먹어.
lines.en: Yeah, I always check the listed calories before eating.
lines.roman: eung, naneun jeokin kallorireul kkok bogo meogeo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 습관이다. 오늘도 같이 열심히 운동하자!
lines.beaver_en: Good habit. Let's work out hard together today too!
lines.beaver_roman: joeun seupgwanida. oneuldo gachi yeolsimhi undonghaja!
lines.learner: 좋아! 다시 살 안 찌게 열심히 하자!
lines.en: Okay! Let's work hard so we don't gain weight again!
lines.roman: joa! dasi sal an jjige yeolsimhi haja!
